licoes.titulo: What do you do? What are you doing?
licoes.objectivo: Descrever o trabalho habitual (present simple) e o deste período (present continuous), escolhendo pelas palavras de tempo.

exercicios.frase: I usually [fix] computers.
This month [I'm working] on a big project.
Sílvia [is preparing] the annual accounts these days.

opcoes.texto: Kalandula Tech is installing networks every day.

exercicios.explicacao: Um facto sobre a empresa: present simple, com -s.

exercicios.enunciado: Which time words go with the present continuous?

opcoes.texto: these days, this month, at the moment
Usually I am check the payments.

exercicios.enunciado: Em que está a trabalhar este mês?
exercicios.resposta: What are you working on this month?

exercicios.frase: I usually support the staff on the phone, but this month I'm working on a big project.
exercicios.enunciado: What is Nuno doing this month?

opcoes.texto: supporting the staff on the phone

exercicios.frase: I usually fix computers, but this month I'm working on a big project.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.
What do you do at work?
exercicios.frase: usually
exercicios.resposta: I'm an accountant. I usually check the payments and I pay the suppliers.
exercicios.contexto: O seu trabalho habitual: present simple.

exercicios.enunciado: And what are you working on these days?
exercicios.frase: I'm
exercicios.resposta: These days I'm preparing a report for a new client, so I'm working late.
exercicios.contexto: O que é temporário: present continuous.

licoes.titulo: I know, I need, I want
licoes.objectivo: Usar os verbos de estado só no present simple e corrigir "I'm knowing" e "I'm needing".

opcoes.texto: I need access to the server room now.
I'm needing access to the server room now.
I needing access to the server room now.

exercicios.explicacao: "Need" é um verbo de estado: present simple, mesmo agora.

opcoes.texto: She has a lot of experience.
She's having a lot of experience.
She have a lot of experience.
I'm having lunch with a client.
I have lunch with a client now.
I having lunch with a client.

exercicios.explicacao: "Have lunch" é uma acção: pode ir para o continuous.

exercicios.frase: I [think] it's a good plan.
Do you [know] Thandi? — No, I don't.
What does "password" [mean]?
No, I don't know her. Who is she?
I don't know her. What does it mean? I don't remember it.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita. "Know": o k não se diz.
What do you need for your work this week?
exercicios.frase: I need
exercicios.resposta: I need a new password and more time. I don't have a printer, so I need one too.

exercicios.enunciado: What do you think of your job?
exercicios.frase: I think
exercicios.resposta: I think it's interesting. I like my colleagues, but I'm very busy these days.

licoes.objectivo: Descrever um colega pela personalidade e pela aparência e distinguir What's she like? de What does she look like?

exercicios.enunciado: "What does she look like?" asks about...

opcoes.texto: He's tall and he has a beard.

exercicios.frase: She [has] short black hair and glasses.
[He's] tall and slim.
She's tall and slim. She has short black hair and glasses. She's in her forties.
She's very friendly and really helpful. She's very organised.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: FRIENDly, HELPful, ORganised.
What does your manager look like?
exercicios.frase: has
exercicios.resposta: She's quite tall. She has long hair and glasses. She's in her fifties.

exercicios.frase: very
exercicios.resposta: She's very hard-working and quite patient, but a bit serious in meetings.
exercicios.contexto: A personalidade, com very, quite, a bit.

licoes.objectivo: Dizer de que é responsável, com quem trabalha e a quem responde; acento dos cognatos; sympathetic e actually.

exercicios.frase: I'm responsible [for] the network.
Paulo and Nuno report [to] Mateus.
She's in charge [of] the finance department.
Sílvia deals [with] the payments.

opcoes.texto: I'm responsible for training new staff.
I'm responsible for train new staff.
I'm responsible to train new staff.
I work in Kalandula Tech for.

exercicios.explicacao: "Sympathetic" quer dizer compreensivo com o problema de alguém.

exercicios.enunciado: "Actualmente trabalho num projecto" em inglês é...

opcoes.texto: Currently, I'm working on a project.
Actually, I'm working on a project.
Actual, I work on a project.

exercicios.frase: Technology.
responsible, technology, development, engineer, analyst, administrator
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita com o acento certo.
Who do you report to, and what are you responsible for?
exercicios.frase: responsible for
exercicios.resposta: I report to the finance manager. I'm responsible for the payments, and I deal with the suppliers.
exercicios.contexto: Use report to e responsible for.

exercicios.enunciado: What do you do in your department? Tell me about one more task.
exercicios.frase: deal with
exercicios.resposta: I work in customer service. I deal with the clients' problems and I look after new clients.
exercicios.contexto: Use deal with ou look after.

licoes.objectivo: Identificar a função, uma responsabilidade e uma característica de cada pessoa em quatro apresentações.

exercicios.frase: I'm the IT manager at Mussulo Energy, so I'm in charge of all the systems there.

opcoes.texto: all the systems at Mussulo Energy

exercicios.frase: People say I'm very organised… and a bit impatient!
I'm in Luanda for three months, so I'm learning some Portuguese. Slowly!
exercicios.enunciado: What is Thandi doing in Luanda, apart from work?

exercicios.frase: I usually start very early because of the time difference — it's four hours later here.
exercicios.enunciado: Why does Arjun start very early?

exercicios.frase: I deal with our clients' payments, so I'm going to test the new system. I report to Rita.
My company sells the equipment for the new network, and I'm responsible for the installation.

exercicios.enunciado: "I'm happy to help with anything you need" quer dizer:

opcoes.texto: Tenho todo o gosto em ajudar no que precisar.
Estou feliz porque preciso de ajuda.

exercicios.enunciado: "Let's start with a quick round of introductions" quer dizer:

opcoes.texto: Vamos começar com uma ronda rápida de apresentações.

exercicios.frase: I'm responsible for the installation. Please send me your questions.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.
You're on the project video call. Introduce yourself.
exercicios.frase: I'm responsible for
exercicios.resposta: Hi, I'm Marta. I'm an analyst at a bank in Luanda. I'm responsible for the monthly reports. People say I'm very patient.
exercicios.contexto: Nome, trabalho, responsabilidade e uma característica.

exercicios.enunciado: What are you working on at the moment, and who do you work with?
exercicios.frase: at the moment
exercicios.resposta: At the moment I'm working on a new system for our clients. I work with two engineers and a designer.
exercicios.contexto: Use o present continuous e "work with".

licoes.titulo: Work & Life: Meet the project team
licoes.objectivo: Apresentar-se e apresentar a função a uma equipa nova, fazer perguntas e apresentar um colega.

exercicios.enunciado: Sou técnico júnior de informática na Kalandula Tech.
exercicios.resposta: I'm a junior IT technician at Kalandula Tech.

exercicios.frase: This week [I'm checking] all the cables.
This is my colleague Paulo. [He's] responsible for the network.

exercicios.enunciado: Which is a friendly follow-up question?

opcoes.texto: What do you do here, exactly?
What is your work, exactly is?

exercicios.enunciado: Which question asks for the right person to call?

opcoes.texto: Who's the contact person for the second floor?
Where is the contact on the second floor?

exercicios.frase: I'm usually in the office from eight to four.
exercicios.enunciado: When is João in the office?

exercicios.frase: He's very reliable — and he knows every cable in this building!
exercicios.enunciado: What does Nuno say about Paulo?
O director diz: "Estou noutra reunião, chego às onze." O que diz à Rita?

opcoes.texto: He says he's in another meeting. He's going to come at eleven.
He is meeting at eleven o'clock another.

exercicios.explicacao: Na mediação, diga a ideia principal em frases simples.

exercicios.frase: So, what do you do here, exactly?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: a voz desce no fim.
Welcome to the team! Please introduce yourself.
exercicios.frase: I report to
exercicios.resposta: Good morning. I'm Carla Tavares. I'm an engineer at Kalandula Tech. I report to Mateus, and I'm responsible for the tests. This week I'm preparing the test plan.
exercicios.contexto: Os quatro passos: nome e função, chefia, responsabilidade e o que está a fazer agora.

exercicios.enunciado: Can you introduce a colleague to me?
exercicios.frase: This is
exercicios.resposta: This is my colleague Joana. She's responsible for the finance team. She's very organised and really helpful.

licoes.objectivo: Rever a unidade 1 e reciclar o A1.

exercicios.frase: I usually [work] from eight to five, but this week [I'm working] late.

exercicios.enunciado: "What's your new boss like?" — Choose the best answer.

opcoes.texto: She's very friendly, but a bit serious.

exercicios.frase: I'm in charge [of] customer service.

opcoes.texto: My colleagues' office is on the second floor.
My colleagues office's is on the second floor.
The office of my colleagues' is on the second floor.

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A1, unidade 10). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I didn't go to the meeting.
I didn't went to the meeting.
I not go to the meeting.

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A1, unidade 10). Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: We're going to start the project in January.
We going to start the project in January.
We're going to started the project in January.

exercicios.enunciado: Reciclagem (A1, unidade 5). Choose the correct sentence.
Reciclagem (A1, unidade 9). Choose the correct sentence.

exercicios.frase: I'm Portuguese, from Lisbon, but I live in Luanda now.

exercicios.enunciado: What are you working on this week, and what do you need for it?
exercicios.frase: I need
exercicios.resposta: This week I'm preparing a presentation for a client. I need some numbers from the finance team.
exercicios.contexto: Present continuous e um verbo de estado.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me about a colleague: their job, what they look like and what they're like.
exercicios.frase: He's
exercicios.resposta: This is Pedro. He works in sales. He's short and he has a beard. He's very funny and really reliable.
